details:
After playing for a little while friends couldn't see or hear me and it wasn't safety settings my avatar was just gone for them. The only way they could make me visible was to click on my outline in the menu and hide then re show me. Or I would have to swap avatars to be seen again. I'm unsure exactly of what the cause could be. I saw another post that avatars would teleport while under laggy circumstances but no one else would teleport. Unless the teleportation is due to local lag?
To hopefully help, there were a variety of different VR headsets being used. It was in a higher population instance since it was at a convention that was going on and it seemed to happen when exiting menus; either in game menus or the index menu button.
If this is indeed the teleportation under lag, it would be a good note on how or why it occurs if it is specifically caused by local lag vs world.
title: Disappearing Avatar
